senses.gloss:
छुर् छुर् (a form of क्षुर्), To cut.
 --Caus. छोरय and छुरय, To inlay with, Kathās. 24, 1.
 --With the prep. आ आ, Caus. To scratch, Kathās. 17, 33.
 --With वि वि, Caus.
 1. [] To inlay with, Kumāras. 1, 56.
 2. To paint, Vikr. d. 136.
 3. To cover, Caurap. 12.
छुरिका छुरिका (a form of क्षुरिका), f. A knife, Kathās. 12, 21.
छूरिका छूरिका, f. The nostril, Man. 8, 325.
